acceptedBy: Name and role of the person who accepts the risk (the store owner, never the auditor)
reason: Why these unverified core checks are accepted, e.g. payment was verified by the owner on the live gateway on 2026-01-15
_note_acceptedUnassessed: Optional. Category keys or names the owner accepts as not assessed (e.g. technical when no theme files or CLI access were given). They still score 0; they only stop blocking High confidence. Remove this line and the key if not needed.
